name: How long does it take to install water-efficient fixtures?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install water-efficient fixtures?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for water-efficient fixtures depends on the number and type of fixtures being replaced. A single faucet or showerhead replacement might take an hour, while a comprehensive upgrade of multiple bathrooms or a kitchen could take a full day or more. For larger projects, we work with clients in Livermore and Pleasanton to schedule installations to minimize inconvenience, often completing work within a day for typical residential upgrades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies; a single fixture might take an hour, while multiple fixtures could take a full day or more.
